newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize mainly firmer on export buys.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize mainly firmer on export buys.

text.p: Argentine cash maize was mainly firmer at midsession Tuesday at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with export interest picking up, traders said.
But volume was low, with supply hard to come by. FAS elevator maize was up $2 for Buenos Aires to $108. FAS elevtaor soybeans were down $2 in Rosario at $292, reflecting lower nearby Chicago prices.
Sunflower seed was steady at $230 in Rosario and Buenos Aires, but crusher interest is picking up. Wheat lost $2 in Quequen to $145, with export interest scant.
